raw.description:
Description

WHO WE ARE

Come join the company at the center of how the world adopts AI securely. Cyera’s mission is to give enterprises the confidence to embrace AI safely — deciding exactly what it can see and do as it reaches deeper into the business. We started by solving the hardest problem in data security: finding and securing data faster and more precisely than anyone thought possible. That foundation is now the essential AI trust infrastructure for the Fortune 1000. We’re hiring mission-driven talent to put those leaders at the center of our story.

THE OPPORTUNITY

As Manager, Channel Operations, you will be the strategic owner of Channel Operations at Cyera. You’ll partner with senior Channel leadership to design scalable processes, define success metrics, and build the operational rigor required to grow partner-sourced and partner-influenced revenue—starting with North America and laying the groundwork for future global scale.

This is a high impactful role, ideal for someone who thrives in ambiguity, enjoys building from first principles, and has prior experience supporting senior Channel leaders in high-growth SaaS environments. You’ll manage one Channel Ops IC who will support execution, while you focus on strategy, structure, and scale.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

Channel Strategy & Operating Model

  • Partner closely with Channel & Alliances leadership to design and evolve the Channel operating model, with a strong focus on scaling success with Cyera’s top strategic partners.
  • Establish clear operational frameworks for how Cyera works with GSIs, Resellers & VARs, Technology Alliances, and CSP partners, aligned to our ICP (G2K and Enterprise).
  • Help define and operationalize the channel operating cadence (QBR inputs, metric reviews, planning cycles, and run-the-business insights).

Metrics, KPIs & Insights

  • Define, monitor, and continuously improve KPIs that measure channel effectiveness and growth, including:
  • Partner-sourced and partner-influenced pipeline and closed-won revenue
  • Deal registration quality, velocity, and conversion
  • Partner activation and engagement
  • Program participation and enablement signals
  • Build executive-ready dashboards and reporting that translate partner activity into actionable insights and clear investment decisions.

Process Ownership & Scale

  • Own and evolve core Channel Ops processes, including:
  • Deal registration lifecycle and governance
  • Partner program operations and enforcement
  • Incentive and SPIFF tracking and readiness
  • Partner enablement and certification tracking
  • Ensure processes are scalable, documented, and built for growth, not one-off execution.

Systems & Tooling

  • Serve as the business owner for Channel Operations workflows in Salesforce (strong understanding required; admin support available).
  • Partner with RevOps Systems and leadership to evaluate, recommend, and scale additional tooling where appropriate (e.g., PRM solutions, analytics tools, marketplace tooling).
  • Support and operationalize cloud marketplace motions (e.g., AWS Marketplace) as part of broader channel workflows and reporting.

Leadership & Collaboration

  • Manage and mentor one Channel Ops IC, providing direction, prioritization, and development.
  • Act as a trusted partner to Channel leadership, Sales, Finance, Marketing, and Enablement to ensure alignment and execution.
  • Bring structure, clarity, and momentum to a rapidly evolving Channel organization.

Requirements

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Experience: 5+ years in Channel Operations, Partner Operations, or GTM Operations supporting partner-led growth in a SaaS environment (cybersecurity strongly preferred).
  • Strategic Operator: Proven ability to build and scale processes in ambiguous, fast-growing organizations; comfortable being both a thought partner and a builder.
  • Channel Fluency: Experience supporting complex partner ecosystems including GSIs, Resellers/VARs, Technology Alliances, and CSPs.
  • Systems & Data Strength: Strong Salesforce expertise with the ability to design reporting, dashboards, and workflows that leadership trusts and uses.
  • Leadership Mindset: Experience managing or mentoring others and operating as a senior partner to Channel leadership.
  • Bias for Scale: You naturally think in terms of repeatability, leverage, and long-term growth rather than short-term fixes.

COMPENSATION INFORMATION:

Compensation Range: $160,000-$200,000.

The range represents total compensation, and may include incentive for sales roles, equity or benefits, as applicable.

This compensation range represents Cyera’s good faith and reasonable estimate of the range of possible compensation for this role at the time of posting, and Cyera may ultimately pay more or less than the posted range. The final salary for this position will be determined in Cyera’s sole discretion, consistent with applicable law, and based on a variety of factors, including but not limited to the employee’s work experience, skills, and qualifications for the role, as well as the needs of Cyera’s business and other operational considerations.

Final compensation will vary based on seniority and relevance of experience, location, and position requirements.

This role may be eligible for potential merit increases based on factors such as individual or company performance, time in role, and other discretionary factors.

BENEFITS - Why Cyera?

  • Ability to work remotely, with office setup reimbursement
  • Competitive salary
  • Unlimited PTO
  • Paid holidays and sick time
  • Health, vision, and dental insurance
  • Life, short and long-term disability insurance

raw.title: Specialist II
raw.excerpt: Job Overview:Assist with the overall Clinical Safety and/or PSS operations associated with products including the entire adverse events process which may include safety data collected from clinical trials and/or post marketing setting (i.
raw.description:
Job Overview:

Assist with the overall Clinical Safety and/or PSS operations associated with products including the entire adverse events process which may include safety data collected from clinical trials and/or post marketing setting (i.e., unsolicited reports). Manage and process expendable adverse events to the required standard and submit them to the client and the regulatory agencies (if required) within the agreed/stated timelines. The post holder is responsible for providing this service to clients either as a support function to the client project groups or as stand-alone business. Responsible to provide all clients, both internal and external, with the appropriate quality of service in a safe and cost-effective manner. He/she will be expected to comply with the legal requirements of the Health and Safety at Work Act 1974, the COSHH regulations 1989 and the EC (European Commission) Directives 1992/3 as documented in the Company’s Health and Safety Manual.

Summary of Responsibilities:

  • Manage the receipt and processing of all adverse event reports reported either spontaneously from any source or solicited from a clinical trial including safety database entry, AE review, write patient narratives with coding, follow-up of missing information, lists assessment against appropriate label (For Marketed products, if applicable).
  • Submission of expedited Serious Adverse Event (SAE) reports to clients, Regulatory Authorities, Ethics Committees, investigators, third party vendors, Partners and Fortrea project personnel, if required and as agreed with client during study set-up, within study specified timelines.
  • Ensure all cases that require expediting reporting to worldwide Regulatory Agencies or other recipients are prioritized for processing and submission within the regulatory and/or study specific applicable timelines.
  • Prepares timely pharmacovigilance reports for products and safety issues, including Individual Case Summary Reports (ICSRs) of Serious Adverse Events (SAEs), Annual IND reports, European Annual Safety Reports (ASRs), Development Safety Update Report (DSUR), Periodic Reports (PRs) line listings, and aggregate reports.
  • Perform peer/independent QC of Safety reports as needed.
  • Work with Data Management or client on reconciliation of safety databases, if appropriate.
  • Maintain a strong understanding of Fortrea’ s safety database conventions or client-specific database conventions, as appropriate.
  • Maintains a comprehensive understanding of Fortrea PSS Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), Work Instructions (WI), guidance documents and directives associated with safety management, reporting, and pharmacovigilance.
  • Assist in signal detection, trend, and pattern recognition activities, as appropriate ¨ Monitor workflow for assigned studies/programs to ensure all the timelines are met.
  • Assist in the development of departmental Work Instructions (WI) and Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), as appropriate.
  • Participate in the generation of monthly status and other project-specific reports ensuring the quality and accuracy of metrics/data provided.
  • Support/train less experienced safety staff in all aspects of case-handling, adverse event reporting and other work, as needed.
  • Begin to prepare Safety Management Plans (SMPs), Reconciliation Plans and other safety- specific plans under supervision.
  • Responsible for making decisions regarding adverse event reporting within the guidelines of each specific project.
  • Actively participates in project team and client meetings and liaise with clients, where appropriate.
  • Assist with proactive quality issue resolution and implementation of actions, as needed.
  • Support audit or inspection preparations.
  • Assist in the review of cumulative safety data for submission to Drug Safety Monitoring Boards (DSMBs), regulatory authorities or clients.
  • Assist with the set-up of, and the provision of data to Safety Committees/DSMBs ¨ Build and maintain good PSS relationships across functional units.
  • Demonstrate role-specific Competencies and company values on a consistent basis.
  • Assist in the co-ordination of endpoint committees, as required.
  • Any other duties as assigned by management.

Qualifications (Minimum Required):

  • Non-degree + 2-3 years of Safety experience or 5 years of relevant experience.
  • Associate degree + 2-3 years of Safety experience or 4 years of relevant experience.
  • BS/BA + 2 years of safety experience or 3-4 years of relevant experience.
  • MS/MA + 2 years of safety experience or 2-3 years of relevant experience.
  • PharmD + 2 years of safety experience or 2-3 years relevant experience.
  • For PharmD, a one-year residency of fellowship can be considered as relevant experience.

Experience (Minimum Required):

  • Good verbal and written communication skills and good presentation skills.
  • Ability to interact and influence with line and middle management, staff, and external contacts on a functional and tactical level.
  • High degree of accuracy with attention to detail.
  • Functions as a team player.
  • Ability to present and share useful business information across departments and functions.
  • Ability to anticipate and identify problems and take appropriate action to correct them.
  • Knowledge of medical and drug terminology.
  • Knowledge of Good Clinical Practice (GCP) related to clinical safety documentation.
  • Knowledge of ICH Guidelines.
  • Knowledge of Medical Device reporting desirable.
  • Knowledge of worldwide regulatory requirements and reporting of adverse event for both marketed and investigational products.
  • Good knowledge and understanding of industry and R and D processes and objectives.
  • Ability to work independently with minimal supervision.
  • Good keyboard skills, preferably with knowledge of MS office and Windows would be beneficial.

Preferred Qualifications Include:

  • Degree preferred to be in one or more of the following disciplines:
  • Biological Sciences, Pharmacy, Nursing, Medical Sciences, Life Sciences, or related area.

Physical Demands/Work Environment:

  • Office environment.

Learn more about our EEO & Accommodations request here.

raw.description:
Our Team

North America Category Management drives the end-to-end category strategy for VistaPrint’s largest commercial region, delivering customer delight and profitable business growth across our wide assortment of customized products. We are a team of marketing, pricing, and multidisciplinary category experts curating a category-level experience that drives both growth and loyalty with high-value customers.

What You Will Do

  • Formulate and execute the holistic commercial strategy as the P&L owner for VistaPrint North America’s emerging growth categories (Signage and Packaging) and Consumer segments, holding comprehensive portfolio governance to achieve sustainable, high-impact financial results.

  • Orchestrate the strategic transition toward high-growth strategic products within Signage and Packaging business lines while seamlessly optimizing operational efficiencies across our foundational Consumer category.

  • Cultivate an entrepreneurial, high-performing culture by providing visionary leadership and development to a multidisciplinary team of category experts focused on delivering exceptional customer experiences.

  • Proactively influence and guide a broad network of embedded, cross-functional resources—including Marketing, Pricing, and Product teams—to synchronize efforts and deliver flawlessly on global category strategies.

  • Operates with customer-first thinking, translating overarching corporate priorities into frictionless, end-to-end customer experiences that lead to successful commercial execution.

  • Lead the technological evolution of regional category systems and processes, driving a steadfast focus on migrating from legacy manual operations to automated, AI-driven commercial methodologies.

  • Collaborate closely with global executive stakeholders to translate complex commercial analytics and key performance metrics into tangible, long-term enterprise value.

Your Qualifications

At VistaPrint, we seek individuals who bring new ideas and perspectives to our teams and improve our culture. No matter your background or experience, we encourage you to apply—even if you feel you don't exactly meet the requirements or qualifications. You might be a strong candidate for this or other roles.

  • Advanced proficiency in digital commerce, demonstrated by 15+ years of business leadership in ecommerce, including 8+ years of people leadership guiding senior teams, or equivalent experience.

  • Proven track record of strategic portfolio governance, successfully managing across multiple complex categories while delivering profitable growth across diverse categories or product lines.

  • Exceptional cross-functional influence with a demonstrated ability to navigate, collaborate, and deliver measurable results within highly matrixed global organizations.

  • Comprehensive understanding of e-commerce ecosystems, backed by a proven track record of customer-first advocacy where deep customer insights have directly driven successful business execution across search, digital merchandising, user experience, and technical product management.

  • Demonstrated aptitude for workflow innovation, including practical experience rethinking legacy business processes and leveraging artificial intelligence (AI) tools to accelerate strategic thinking, optimize daily ways of working, and scale team output, or equivalent experience.

  • Solid foundational understanding of data analytics, possessing the analytical precision required to transform high-level commercial metrics into clear actionable business strategies.

Nice to Have

  • Master of Business Administration (MBA) degree, or an equivalent advanced degree in Business, Marketing, or a related technical field.

  • Working knowledge of localized supply chain logistics and manufacturing workflows for custom print-on-demand or packaging networks.

Why You'll Love Working Here

There is a lot to love about working at VistaPrint. We are an award winning Remote-First company. We’re an inclusive community. We’re growing (which means you can too). And to help orient us all in the same direction, we have our Vista Behaviors which exemplify the behavioral attributes that make us a culturally strong and high-performing team.

About Us

VistaPrint is the design and marketing partner to millions of small businesses around the world. For over 20 years we’ve been inspired by small businesses, and we work incessantly to deliver solutions to their evolving needs. Together, VistaCreate, 99designs by Vista and VistaPrint represent a full-service design, digital and print solution, elevating small businesses’ presence in physical and digital spaces and powering them to achieve success. VistaPrint is focused on making great marketing and design accessible to every small business owner, allowing them to create a cohesive brand image for use in-store, online and on-the-go.

Commitment to Diversity, Equity, & Inclusion

VistaPrint exists to help our customers live their dreams. Each dream is unique – and the VistaPrint team needs to be as well. We believe in the unique contributions of everyone within a diverse global organization. We are collaborative, inclusive, and innovative. We strive to role model and live an inclusive culture of fairness, respect and belonging for all. And we work together to empower each other, creating a space in which each of us can spark our next great idea.

Equal Opportunity Employer

VistaPrint, a Cimpress company, is an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer. All qualified candidates will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, sex, national or ethnic origin, nationality, age, religion, citizenship, disability, medical condition, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender presentation, legal or preferred name, marital status, pregnancy, family structure, veteran status or any other basis protected by human rights laws or regulations. This list is not exhaustive and, in fact, in many cases, we strive to do more than the law requires.

Due to current US government policy changes, we are currently not sponsoring new H-1B petitions subject to the $100,000 filing fee under the September 2025 Presidential Proclamation. Candidates with existing work authorization or H-1B status not subject to this fee may still be considered.

Compensation:

US Target Hiring Range :$265,000.00 - $450,000.00 Per Year

Cimpress/Vista is committed to transparent and competitive compensation. In alignment with our compensation philosophy,
the target hiring range is based on total cash compensation across our multiple U.S. pay zones. The actual salary offered will depend on factors such as location, education, training, and experience. Cimpress/Vista offers a comprehensive benefits package, including health, wealth and wellness programs, as well as long-term equity incentives, subject to eligibility.

WHAT DOES A VP, CLIENT SERVICES DO?

The VP of Client Services will have ownership of the senior-level client and agency partner relationships beyond the day-to-day operations. This person will be responsible for client retention by maintaining executive- and senior-level relationships and identifying additional opportunities with existing clients. They are responsible for assessing and managing the risk associated with clients and agency partners, as well as meeting client and EVERSANA INTOUCH goals for each account’s financial health, targets, and objectives. They lead the coordination and development of the integrated marketing plans internally and with external agency partners. Strong thought leadership within EVERSANA INTOUCH and within the industry is required, along with the ability to bring new services to our clients frequently, allowing them to understand the depth of EVERSANA INTOUCH’s offerings. 

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:

Our employees are tasked with delivering excellent business results through the efforts of their teams. These results are achieved by:

  • modeling inclusive behaviors, and proactively managing bias.

  • All other duties as assigned.

WHAT ARE WE LOOKING FOR?

  • Approximately 12 to 15 years of agency, consultative, pharmaceutical and/or healthcare experience is required 

  • Thought leader for integrated and digital marketing and communications 

  • Self-sufficient and self-motivated with the ability to independently manage major clients and brands 

  • Demonstrated P&L targets met through existing and expansion business opportunities 

  • Proven leadership and mentoring skills 

  • Leader of cross-functional project teams across the organization 

  • Experience negotiating and executing agreements 

  • Creative thinker with analytical skills 

  • Ability to collaborate effectively at all levels and functions 

  • Applied understanding of technical development and processes 

  • Demonstrated problem-solving skills 

  • Ability to determine staffing needs within the account team and extended teams 

  • Bachelor’s degree required in Business, Marketing, Journalism or Communications 

  • Demonstrated written, presentation and verbal communication skills 

  • Excellent interpersonal skills; able to interact at all levels with clients and the Intouch organization 

  • Travel required 

OUR CULTURAL BELIEFS:

Patient Minded I act with the patient’s best interest in mind.

Client Delight I own every client experience and its impact on results.

Take Action I am empowered and empower others to act now.

Grow Talent I own my development and invest in the development of others. 

Win Together I passionately connect with anyone, anywhere, anytime to achieve results.

Communication Matters I speak up to create transparent, thoughtful and timely dialogue.

Embrace Diversity I create an environment of awareness and respect.

Always Innovate I am bold and creative in everything I do.

Our team is aware of recent fraudulent job offers in the market, misrepresenting EVERSANA. Recruitment fraud is a sophisticated scam commonly perpetrated through online services using fake websites, unsolicited e-mails, or even text messages claiming to be a legitimate company. Some of these scams request personal information and even payment for training or job application fees. Please know EVERSANA would never require personal information nor payment of any kind during the employment process. We respect the personal rights of all candidates looking to explore careers at EVERSANA.

EVERSANA is committed to providing competitive salaries and benefits for all employees. If this job posting includes a base salary range, it represents the low and high end of the salary range for this position and is not applicable to locations outside of the U.S. Compensation will be determined based on relevant experience, other job-related qualifications/skills, and geographic location (to account for comparative cost of living). More information about EVERSANA’s benefits package can be found at eversana.com/careers. EVERSANA reserves the right to modify this base salary range and benefits at any time.

From EVERSANA’s inception, Diversity, Equity & Inclusion have always been key to our success. We are an Equal Opportunity Employer, and our employees are people with different strengths, experiences, and backgrounds who share a passion for improving the lives of patients and leading innovation within the healthcare industry. Diversity not only includes race and gender identity, but also age, disability status, veteran status, sexual orientation, religion, and many other parts of one’s identity. All of our employees’ points of view are key to our success, and inclusion is everyone's responsibility.

Consistent with the Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) and applicable state and local laws, it is the policy of EVERSANA to provide reasonable accommodation when requested by a qualified applicant or candidate with a disability, unless such accommodation would cause an undue hardship for EVERSANA. The policy regarding requests for reasonable accommodations applies to all aspects of the hiring process. If reasonable accommodation is needed to participate in the interview and hiring process, please contact us at applicantsupport@eversana.com.

Follow us on LinkedIn | Twitter

EVERSANA INTOUCH® is a global, full-service marketing agency network serving the life sciences industry, and is the first – and only – agency network to be part of a fully integrated commercialization platform through EVERSANA®. We provide next-generation creative and media services, enterprise solutions and data analytics services for clients.

We get fired up when people talk about getting—and staying—healthy. That’s where we find our inspiration: in the very human experiences of patients, doctors, and even each other. Then, we collaborate on ways to make caring for one’s health more achievable, connecting patients and physicians with the information and tools they need.

We embrace diversity in backgrounds and experiences. Improving patient lives around the world is a priority, and we need people from all backgrounds and swaths of life to help build the future of the healthcare and the life sciences industry. We believe our people make all the difference in cultivating an inclusive culture that embraces our cultural beliefs.

About Avalere Health

United by one profound purpose: to reach EVERY PATIENT POSSIBLE. At Avalere Health, we ensure every patient is identified, treated, supported, and cared for. Equally. Our Advisory, Medical, and Marketing teams come together – powerfully and intentionally – to forge unconventional connections, building a future where healthcare is not a barrier and no patient is left behind.
Achieving our mission starts with providing enriching, purpose-driven careers for our team that empower them to make a tangible impact on patient lives. We are committed to creating a culture where our employees are empowered to bring their whole selves to work and tap into the power of diverse backgrounds and skillsets to play a part in making a difference for every patient, everywhere.
Our flexible approach to working allows our global teams to decide where they want to work, whether in-office or at home based on team and client need. Major city hubs in London, Manchester, Washington, D.C., and New York, and smaller offices globally, serve as collaboration hubs allowing our teams to come together when it matters. Homeworkers are equally supported, with dedicated social opportunities and resources.
Our inclusive culture is at the heart of everything we do. We proudly support our employees in bringing their whole selves to work with our six Employee Network Groups – Diverse Ability, Family, Gender, LGBTQ+, Mental Health, and Race/Ethnicity. These groups provide opportunities to promote diversity, equity, and inclusion and to connect, learn, and socialise through regular meetings and programs of activity. We are an accredited Fertility Friendly employer with our Fertility Policy, enhanced parental leave, and culture of flexibility ensuring every employee feels supported across their family planning journey and can work in a way that suits their family’s needs.
We are deeply invested in supporting professional growth for our employees through day-to-day career experiences, access to thousands of on-demand training sessions, regular career conversations, and the opportunity for global, cross-capability career moves.
We take pride in being part of the Disability Confident Scheme. This helps make sure you can be interviewed fairly if you have a disability, long term health condition, or are neurodiverse. If you'd like to apply and need adjustments made, you can let us know in your application.

About the role

The Copy Supervisor will conceptualize and develop materials for assigned products, and train direct reports to enhance their abilities. You will participate in strategic promotional planning for assigned products and present concepts and promotional materials to the client. You will also partner with the Art Directors to develop creative concepts and executions for assigned products. 

What you'll do

    • Write effective promotional copy, acting as a primary copywriter on at least one product. 

    • Review material produced by direct reports, as applicable, including review of final manuscripts, as applicable 

    • Supervise senior copywriter(s), copywriter(s) and junior copywriter(s), as applicable 

    • Demonstrate thorough knowledge of assigned therapeutic categories 

    • Participate in strategic promotional planning for assigned products 

    • Understand and ensure compliance with the editorial process 

    • Demonstrate mastery of manuscript submission process, including referencing and regulatory details of assigned product(s) 

    • Interact with Art Directors to develop creative concepts and executions for assigned products 

    • Present concepts and promotional material to the client 

    • Assist in product launches 

About you

    • 5-7 years of professional writing experience, with at least 2 years of pharmaceutical advertising copywriting experience 

    • At least 2 years of supervisory experience 

    • Demonstrated track record for independently producing successful, compelling, and strategically sound pharmaceutical promotional materials in 2 or more therapeutic categories 

    • Comfortable working within tight deadlines 

    • Advanced Mac experience with all Adobe Creative Suite and MS Office Suite

What we can offer

You will receive a 401K plan with an employer match contribution up to 4% (immediately vested), as well as life insurance, disability coverage, and medical, dental, and vision plans for peace of mind. Enjoy flexible working arrangements, including hybrid and remote work, along with the option to work from anywhere across the globe two weeks each year. We provide 20 vacation days plus one personal well-being day, recognise 9 public holidays, along with gifted end-of-year holidays and an early Summer Friday finish in June, July, and August.
Access free counselling through our employee assistance program and personalized health support. Our enhanced maternity, paternity, family leave, and fertility policies provide support across every stage of your family-planning journey. You can also benefit from continuous opportunities to professionally develop with on-demand training, support, and global mobility opportunities across the business.
We encourage all applicants to read our candidate privacy noticebefore applying to Avalere Health.

raw.excerpt: Why Join GEICO? At GEICO, we offer a rewarding career where your ambitions are met with endless possibilities.
raw.description:
Why Join GEICO?

At GEICO, we offer a rewarding career where your ambitions are met with endless possibilities.

Every day we honor our iconic brand by offering quality coverage to millions of customers and being there when they need us most. We thrive on relentless innovation to exceed our customers' expectations while making a real impact on local communities nationwide.

Founded in 1936, GEICO is a member of the Berkshire Hathaway family of companies and one of the largest auto insurers in the United States. When you join our company, we want you to feel valued, supported, and proud to work here. That's why we offer the GEICO Pledge: Great Company, Great Culture, Great Rewards, and Great Careers.

Sr. Manager, National Account Agency Operations

LOCATION:

  • Remote (Texas preferred) with travel up to 50% to accounts, events and sales conference.
  • Opportunity to work in available office space at a regional GEICO office, not required

GEICO seeks highly motivated and experienced Sr. Manager, National Account Agency Operations to join our team. The successful candidate will directly report to a National Account Director and will be responsible for working within a discrete group of key accounts and creating and implementing strategic account plans to increase sales profitability, written premium and policies in force. This exciting role will have a direct influence and impact on GEICOs market share in America’s largest agencies.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Manage account call center locations, assist with broad reach and other electronic group training and advancement campaigns.

  • Develop and maintain strong working relationships with key account location managers, producers and account influencers to influence preference for GEICO and their affiliate products.

  • Build, execute and present location specific strategic account plans, and forecasts to achieve company objectives and sales targets supporting the NA Director strategic roadmap for specific accounts and products.

  • The chosen candidate should possess executive communication and negotiation skills and a strong ability to collaborate and build relationships with customers and internal teams from corporate headquarters to regional to individual office locations.

  • Responsible for working with all GEICO product lines i.e. Private Passenger Auto, Commercial Auto & Trucking

  • Collaborating with the GEICO distribution and process teams to share and execute growth strategies, provide process guidance, and spend time with field and inside reps engaging National Account agency locations.

  • Facilitates calibration sessions with Field and Inside sales resources to build consistency on the execution of NA account strategies, call subject consistency and other growth/quality initiatives

  • Coordinate sales strategies clearly and accurately with AOM field counterparts to ensure NA account strategies are cascaded appropriately into all relevant deployments

  • Communicate regularly with, and to customers and GEICO Field and Inside sales leadership to proactively identify and address any concerns or issues while maintaining excellent customer service.

  • Collaborate closely cross-functionally with internal teams such as service, underwriting, sales support, and IT to ensure roadmaps and communication for key initiatives and projects remain aligned and well distributed to key function team members.

  • Establish additional target agencies with similar operating characteristics as resources and experience allow.

  • Monitor and report on sales performance, identifying areas for improvement and recommending appropriate actions to remediate performance.

  • Work with your Director to establish staff execution plans to grow production to goals in assigned locations, and territories/states.

  • Support and execute innovative and practical solutions with go-to-market strategies across all sales deployment groups for commercial and personal lines products.

  • Regularly monitor Agency onboarding and enablement, collecting and elevating opportunities to improve the agent experience, driving preference and sales.

QUALIFICATIONS:

  • 3 + years of experience as an sales resource involved with large, complex customers.

  • Bachelor's degree in a business or related field

  • Proven track record of successfully developing and translating sales strategy into results.

  • Experience collaborating with key resources and stakeholders, influencing decisions and managing work to achieve both short-and-long term strategic goals.

  • Attention to detail and ability to adapt to ongoing change.

  • Exceptional written, verbal communication and presentation skills.

  • Compliance with GEICO’s driving standards and/or policy.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS:

  • 7+ years of experience in the personal and commercial lines and related coverages in all sizes and shapes of agencies.

  • MBA or similar advanced degree is preferred.

Annual Salary

raw.description:
We are excited to speak to you about this opportunity. If you are interested in joining our growing team, please apply to this link directly.

Who we need

Infinity Software has been part of Aquila since 2021. We build software that helps alternative lending institutions lend money to all individuals regardless of their financial history. At Infinity, we recognize that the only way for our clients to perform better is for our software to outperform the status quo, surpass the competition, and exceed expectations. Our highly customizable platform delivers functionality to manage loan products, marketing campaigns, collections, analytics, and reporting with precision and efficiency.

Reporting to the Director of Operations, we are hiring a Manager of Infrastructure to lead the evolution of our cloud infrastructure, DevOps, and quality assurance functions while helping shape the future of the Infinity platform. As our new Manager of Infrastructure, you will balance strategic leadership with technical execution, guiding infrastructure architecture, modernizing our Azure environment, and building the systems, processes, and automation that enable reliable, scalable software delivery. Working closely with Product, Development, and business leaders, you will help strengthen platform performance, improve operational efficiency, advance AI initiatives, and create the technical foundation that allows us to continue delivering on our promise of software our customers will not outgrow. You will also lead and develop a small team while influencing technical direction across the broader engineering organization.

This is a full-time remote opportunity open to candidates across the United States and Canada.

What’s in it for you

Ownership. This is an opportunity to shape the future of infrastructure at Infinity. Following our transition from on-premises infrastructure to Azure, you will have the autonomy to modernize our cloud environment, strengthen reliability and performance, introduce automation, and build the technical foundation that supports continuous delivery and future growth. Your ideas and expertise will directly influence how we evolve our platform.

Impact. Infrastructure is at the heart of everything we deliver to our customers. You will lead initiatives that improve system performance, reduce downtime, strengthen scalability, and enable new AI-powered capabilities across our products. Working closely with Product and Development, you will help ensure we continue delivering software our customers can depend on today while building for tomorrow.

Leadership and growth. This is a player-coach leadership role where you will have the opportunity to mentor and develop a growing team while remaining close to the technology. As part of Constellation Software, you will have access to continuous learning, leadership development, and opportunities to advance your career within Infinity, Aquila, or another business unit. Whether your ambition is to deepen your technical expertise or grow into broader technology leadership, you will have the support and opportunity to do so.

How you will make an impact:

  • Lead infrastructure strategy and modernization. You will define and execute the roadmap for Infinity's cloud infrastructure, ensuring it is secure, scalable, reliable, and aligned with the long-term needs of the business. You will evaluate emerging technologies, recommend architectural improvements, and guide the ongoing evolution of our Azure environment to improve performance, resilience, and operational efficiency.
  • Build a modern DevOps practice. You will strengthen our deployment and operational capabilities by advancing infrastructure automation, CI/CD pipelines, monitoring, logging, and automated testing. You will champion best practices that reduce manual effort, improve release quality, minimize outages, and support continuous delivery across our software platform.
  • Drive innovation through AI and emerging technologies. You will lead the evaluation and adoption of AI-powered capabilities that enhance both our internal operations and our product offerings. Working closely with Product and Development, you will identify opportunities to integrate new technologies, accelerate delivery, and create innovative solutions that deliver greater value to our customers.
  • Lead and develop the team. You will coach, mentor, and support a small team of Infrastructure, DevOps, and QA professionals, fostering a culture of accountability, collaboration, continuous learning, and technical excellence. As a hands-on leader, you will remove obstacles, provide technical guidance, and help your team grow while remaining actively involved in solving complex technical challenges.
  • Partner across the business. You will work closely with Product, Development, and business leaders to understand priorities, balance technical and business needs, and ensure infrastructure decisions enable product innovation and exceptional customer experiences. You will communicate clearly with stakeholders, helping translate technical concepts into practical business outcomes.

Here’s what you bring:

  • The leadership. You have experience leading and developing technical teams, creating an environment where people are empowered to do their best work while remaining accountable for outcomes. You bring a coaching mindset to leadership, balancing mentorship with clear expectations, thoughtful feedback, and a commitment to continuous improvement.
  • The infrastructure expertise. You have experience designing, building, and supporting secure, scalable cloud infrastructure in Microsoft Azure. You understand modern infrastructure architecture, networking, security, monitoring, disaster recovery, and performance optimization, and you can confidently guide technical decisions that improve reliability and scalability.
  • The DevOps mindset. You have experience building and improving infrastructure automation, CI/CD pipelines, Infrastructure as Code, and automated testing practices. You are passionate about creating efficient, repeatable processes that improve software quality, accelerate releases, and reduce operational risk.
  • The technical curiosity. You stay current with emerging technologies and enjoy exploring new ways to solve business challenges. You are excited by opportunities to leverage AI, automation, and modern cloud technologies to improve internal operations and enhance customer-facing products.
  • The strategic and analytical thinking. You can evaluate technical and business requirements, identify patterns, assess trade-offs, and recommend practical solutions that balance short-term priorities with long-term scalability. You are comfortable making decisions in evolving environments and communicating the reasoning behind them.
  • The collaboration and communication skills. You build trusted relationships across Product, Development, and business teams, translating complex technical concepts into clear recommendations for a variety of audiences. You are an approachable, collaborative leader who values diverse perspectives and works effectively across functions to achieve shared goals.

Why join?

Aquila is a division of Constellation Software Inc., one of the largest and most successful software companies in Canada and the most successful technology stock in Canada over the last 10 years [TSE: CSU].

Our entrepreneurial culture, lean environment, and people come together to form a dynamic organization where purpose drives our growth. This is a place where high performance and hard work are rewarded, where leaders are grown, and where the best ideas win. With the autonomy to be creative and curious, we collaborate and iterate to achieve real impact in the communities we support.

We spend our days asking questions and challenging the status quo, manipulating our structure, roles, and internal operations in order to stay ahead in a competitive landscape.

If you share our growth mindset, relationship-focused approach, and high moral fiber, you will thrive at Aquila.

Apply now.

Diversity and inclusion are not mere words on paper to us. We welcome and appreciate candidates with a range of backgrounds and experiences. If you have most of the qualifications we are seeking, and want to play an integral role in our success, apply to express your interest.

What you can expect from our interview process:

  • A virtual interview with a Talent Advisor to discuss your interest in joining Infinity and your experience. The conversation will be recorded using BrightHire, an AI-powered interview platform. More details will be shared when you are invited to interview.
  • A virtual interview with the Director of Operations, Infinity focused on your experience leading infrastructure teams, modernizing cloud environments, driving DevOps practices, and partnering across technical and business teams.
  • A technical discussion or working session with the Manager of Development at Infinity where you will have the opportunity to talk through your approach to infrastructure architecture, cloud modernization, automation, and solving complex technical challenges.
  • A final virtual interview with the VP of Technology at Aquila to discuss leadership style, collaboration, technical vision, and how you would help shape the future of infrastructure at Infinity.

Aquila welcomes and encourages applications from people with disabilities. Accommodations are available on request for candidates taking part in all aspects of the selection process.

raw.title: Level I Trauma Abstractor
raw.excerpt: Why ADN?  Join the American Data Network family and become part of an established, purpose-driven healthcare quality organization with more than 30 years of experience.
raw.description:
Why ADN? Join the American Data Network family and become part of an established, purpose-driven healthcare quality organization with more than 30 years of experience. At ADN, our work supports hospitals and healthcare clients in improving quality, patient safety, and clinical outcomes. We value integrity, accuracy, collaboration, and professionalism, and we are looking for experienced abstractors who take pride in producing high-quality work.

Position Summary: American Data Network is seeking experienced Level I Trauma Abstractors to support accurate and timely trauma abstraction for assigned healthcare clients. This role is ideal for candidates with recent, hands-on Level I Trauma abstraction experience who can independently review clinical documentation, apply registry specifications, and meet assigned deadlines with a high level of accuracy.

This is not a general data entry position. Candidates must have direct healthcare registry, clinical chart review, quality reporting, or data abstraction experience specific to Level I Trauma.

Position Details: ADN hires both contractors and full-time employees for Data Abstraction roles. Contractors must be available for a minimum of 15 hours per week.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Reviews patient medical records and abstracts data for the Trauma Registry.
  • Applies registry specifications, definitions, inclusion and exclusion criteria, and abstraction guidelines accurately and consistently.
  • Interprets clinical documentation and abstracts detailed injury and care data into the trauma registry database, including mechanism of injury, injury severity, clinical course, interventions, complications, and outcomes in accordance with Level I trauma standards.
  • Enters accurate and complete data into assigned registry platforms, EHRs, vendor tools, or other data collection systems.
  • Maintains a high level of abstraction accuracy, completeness, and attention to detail.
  • Meets assigned productivity expectations, weekly progress goals, and internal and client deadlines.
  • Participates in quality assurance activities, including feedback, correction, validation, and IRR reviews.
  • Communicates professionally with account leads, team members, and client contacts when clarification is needed.
  • Maintains strict confidentiality and complies with ADN, client, HIPAA, and data security requirements.

Qualifications:

Required:

  • At least 2 years of recent Level I Trauma Registry abstraction experience.
  • Current trauma registry and coding education is required, including documentation of completion for the Trauma Registry Course, AAAM AIS Coding Course, and an ICD-10 coding course completed within the past five years.
  • Ability to independently abstract Level I Trauma cases using registry specifications and clinical documentation.
  • Strong understanding of healthcare quality reporting, registry abstraction, clinical documentation review, and medical record interpretation.
  • Ability to work independently with minimal supervision while maintaining accuracy and meeting deadlines.
  • Strong attention to detail, organization, documentation, and follow-through.
  • Comfort working in multiple EHRs, registry platforms, vendor tools, and data collection systems as assigned.
  • Excellent interpersonal and written communication skills.
  • Contractors must have high-speed secure internet, a PC or laptop, and at least two monitors.

Preferred:

  • Experience using trauma applications, Level I Trauma reports, and/or other related data collection tools.
  • Experience with IRR, QA review, audit validation, and/or abstraction accuracy review.

Screening & Onboarding: Qualified candidates will complete an initial phone screen and a Trauma-specific abstraction assessment. The assessment is designed to evaluate understanding of registry specifications, abstraction judgment, accuracy, and completion speed.

ADN does not provide Level I Trauma abstraction training, so candidates should already have the registry experience needed for the role. After hire, ADN provides onboarding to ADN processes, client systems, EHR access, documentation tendencies, and other client-specific workflows.

Why This Role May Be a Good Fit: This position may be a strong fit for experienced Level I Trauma abstractors who enjoy independent work, flexible scheduling, registry-based chart review, healthcare quality reporting, and contributing to meaningful work that supports hospitals and patient care. ADN offers a knowledgeable and supportive team environment, multiple registry opportunities, and potential growth into lead or expanded quality roles for strong performers.

Due to our continued growth, Precision for Medicine is looking for a Senior Feasibility Associate/Feasibility Manager to join our European team. This position can be covered fully remotely in UK, Spain, Hungary, Poland, Romania, Serbia or Slovakia.

Position Summary:

The Senior Feasibility Associate/Feasibility Manager is a member of the expert team within Feasibility Department of Precision for Medicine. As part of this team, this role has responsibility to support the delivery of pre-award, post-award, rescue, and stand-alone-feasibility projects. The Senior Feasibility Associate/Feasibility Manager supports pre-award feasibility projects and support business development and operational strategy teams by conducting feasibility analysis. The Senior Feasibility Associate/Feasibility Manager supports stand-alone feasibility projects and site identification and is providing feasibility support for newly awarded and/or ongoing projects. In addition, Senior Feasibility Associate/Feasibility Manager may participate in specific projects that enables Precision for Medicine to stay at the forefront of innovation and maintain their competitive edge as a scientifically driven engaged partner for our biotech and pharma clients.

Essential functions of the job include but are not limited to:

Support pre-award feasibility projects

  • Provide pre-award feasibility analysis and input for pre-award RFPs, including competitive analysis, historical recruitment analysis, standards of care, drug analysis, epidemiology analysis, site and country analysis.
  • Review clinical protocols, study assumptions, client information and study plans for US and global trials.
  • Present and explain feasibility analysis to BD/Clients, including the process, recommendations, and rationale.
  • Interface with colleagues, consultants and partners and collaborate with internal and external sources to gather and share feasibility information.
  • Undertake feasibility site outreach for pre award opportunities.
  • Participate and/or contribute to BDM and client calls.

Provide support to post-award feasibility projects

  • Undertake post-award, rescue, and standalone feasibility deliverables in alignment with study and client requirements.
  • Where appropriate, engage with patient advocacy groups and site networks to support study feasibility, recruitment, and successful delivery.
  • Support the analysis of the collected site data to provide accurate site identification, enrollment modeling and study strategy (ies)

Minimum required:

  • Bachelor’s degree in a life sciences discipline
  • A minimum of 5 years of related experience
  • Combination of qualifications and equivalent relevant experience may be accepted as an alternative.

Other Required:

  • Relevant experience in the required activities for the role including feasibility analysis, site identification.
  • Ability to communicate both verbally and in writing at the English proficiently (Professional level) Preferred:

  • Strong rationale and analytical thinking
  • Strong IT platform and data analysis skills
  • Strong presentation abilities

  • Strong sense of ownership and pride in quality of outputs

Overview

Project Objective

Fòs Feminista is issuing this RFP to solicit proposals from qualified travel service agencies located in Africa. Beyond the specific questions outlined below, FÒS FEMINISTA seeks a partner who:

  • Provides top notch multi-lingual customer service to travelers.
  • Can demonstrate a proactive culture of service, treating FÒS FEMINISTA’s travel spend as its own.
  • Is uniquely adept at booking and providing subject matter expertise for complex international trips.
  • Provides timely and detailed reporting to facilitate travel expense reporting and audit compliance.

Request for Proposal

FÒS FEMINISTA makes no representations, warranties, or agreements with respect to this RFP. In addition, FÒS FEMINISTA makes no commitment to purchase any products or services or take any other action, including but not limited to, awarding a contract to the supplier submitting the lowest cost proposal. Material contained in this RFP is to be considered confidential and proprietary information, subject to restrictions outlined here. FÒS FEMINISTA reserves the right to amend or cancel this RFP at any time for any or no reason. All amendments to this RFP shall be made in writing.

RFP Timeline

  • RFP Advertised: March 5, 2026
  • RFP Responses due: April 30, 2026
  • Initial Evaluation complete: May 15, 2026
  • Interviews with Finalists / Agency Award: June 15, 2026
  • Services in effect: As soon as possible

Above dates are subject to change, and respondents will be notified per the above.

About FÒS FEMINISTA

Fòs Feminista is an intersectional feminist organization centered around the sexual and reproductive rights and needs of women, girls, and gender-diverse people. Led and governed by the Global South, Fòs Feminista works as an alliance of organizations in 35 countries worldwide to advance sexual and reproductive health, rights, and justice (SRHRJ).

Fòs Feminista is both the connective tissue that links these diverse partners in an alliance and an active participant in the broader ecosystem of actors working on SRHRJ. We connect partners across movements and borders, amplify innovative partner-led solutions, and catalyze political will and resources for an intersectional feminist agenda on SRHRJ.

Fòs Feminista’s role is to facilitate transnational and transregional collaboration, advocacy, research, policy work and learning among partners; amplify partners’ work and voices; accompany partners’ institutional strengthening; and catalyze and channel funding to support partners’ work. For more information on FÒS FEMINISTA, please visit the external website at www.fosfeminista.org.

FÒS FEMINISTA currently has 64 employees and has offices in New York, Mexico, and operates in the following countries:

Africa: Cote d’Ivoire, Kenya, Nigeria, Senegal, Tanzania

Asia: India, Philippines

Europe: United Kingdom, Spain

Latin America and The Caribbean: Argentina, Brazil, Colombia, Honduras, Mexico, Panama, Uruguay

Middle East: UAE

North America: Canada, United States

Current Travel Program

In 2025, Fòs Feminista ‘s annual travel spending was roughly USD $1 million, and the vast amount of our travel (over 90%) was international with a few US domestic trips.

RFP Process & Information

Proposal Submission

Proposals must address and respond to all issues raised in the RFP. Proposals are expected to be binding for a period of one hundred and twenty (120) days from the published response date.

RFP Questions & Criteria

Minimum Requirements (please answer yes or no)

- Has your company been in business for at least five years?

- What languages do your agents speak (English and French is a must. Spanish is an advantage)?

- What is the Annual gross travel booking?

- Do you provide 24/7 service.?

- Does not outsource after-hours service.

- Do you have the ability to manage passenger profiles?

- Is more than 50% of your business international business travel ?

- Are you eligible to serve as an organization that receives funding from the US government, the UN, and the European Union?

While firms will not be disqualified out of hand if any of the above criteria are not met, these are vital components of any proposal and will be weighted appropriately. Firms that qualify according to the above pass/fail criteria should respond to the questions below:

RFP Questions

Please present your responses in precisely the same sequence as the questions are presented here. Please use the Question Outline as stated here.

General/Overview

  1. Please introduce your Team and services and why you are interested in servicing our travel needs? Also provide a brief overview of why you believe you are best suited to provide travel management services to FÒS FEMINISTA.
  2. Define the implementation of timing and process upon selection.

Experience of the Agency

  1. Describe the mix of clients you currently have and your experience in booking travel in the Global South and particularly in Africa arranging travel to FÒS FEMINISTA’s operating locations.

Technical Approach to FÒS FEMINISTA’s Requirements

Account Management

  1. Describe the primary duties of the account manager. What language capabilities do they have?
  2. Will FÒS FEMINISTA receive a designated team and a point of contact person? Will the agents be able to assist with training and credit card reconciliation?

Operations

  1. Describe your organizational and reporting structure.
  2. Describe your basic operations including but not limited to location of call center(s), operating hours, average length of agent experience, agent turnover rate, automation, quality control.
  3. Do you have any language capacity, writing and verbal skills? Specifically, Spanish, French, and Portuguese?
  4. Explain the standard flight booking process, response time, and tracking customer service issues. Do you have statistics on response time? How many options do you present?
  5. How do you ensure quality control and error-free booking?
  6. Explain how you address situations in which a traveler (or travel arranger) has found a lower fare through an alternate source.
  7. What procedures and data do you have to ensure that your prices are competitive? Do you have access to humanitarian fares if necessary?
  8. Are there any carriers that you are not able to book trips with, for example, airlines that don’t place their tickets in typical reservation systems?
  9. Occasionally, there are times when we may not need to book flights and just need assistance with booking hotels. Is this something you can assist with?
  10. Do you offer access to agents via chat tools such as WhatsApp, Skype or Microsoft Teams?
  11. Describe your after-hours emergency service including, but not limited to: the location of the call center(s), hours (24/7?), additional costs if any, who operates the call centers, how quality standards are maintained, number of agents, access to payment information and profiles, language capability, etc.
  12. Please provide your standard traveler profile form. Do you have an automated traveler profile system? Can travelers access it and update it online? Where are the profiles stored? Does it cover frequent flyer accounts, meals, and seating preferences?
  13. What security and privacy controls do you have in place to ensure that sensitive and confidential data does not get leaked, e.g. travelers’ passport information, credit card information, etc.?
  14. Are your agents familiar with entry requirements/ flag visa requirements based on traveler profiles?
  15. Do you offer an automated workflow for travel authorization prior to purchase, including tracking accounting codes?
  16. Do you provide automatic notifications of travel incidents around the world (airport closures, airline worker strikes, etc.)?
  17. Do you provide real-time alerts, security evacuations and crisis support on emerging situations specific to the areas where travelers are traveling to? How do travelers receive alerts and travel information?
  18. How are real-time delays or cancellations communicated to travelers? Is there a mobile app where travelers can download?

Financial - Pricing

  1. Please provide detailed pricing including any additional or ancillary costs that we would incur. Provide reasoning as to why the proposed pricing model is best for FÒS FEMINISTA.
  2. Outline any other additional services and products that have an additional cost.
  3. Would you be able to provide monthly invoice report in a specific format with information such as traveler’s name, booking reference #, airline/hotel information, itinerary, departure/arrival time, total cost, credit/refund, international fee, exchange rate, cancellation fee?

Additional Services

  1. Please describe any additional services or amenities that will be available to FÒS FEMINISTA and its travelers.
  2. What types of training and orientation tools do you have for travelers, both at the start of an organizational relationship and as new travelers come on board?
  3. Do you offer any resources to assist or manage the visa or vaccination process for traveling FÒS FEMINISTA staffers?
  4. Do you have programs around environmental sustainability/carbon offsetting for travel?
  5. Do you have any programs on selecting travel methods and routes with lower environmental impact?

Non-Disclosure and Confidentiality

The terms of this RFP and all associated information sent to you by us are proprietary and confidential. These materials are to be used by you solely for the purpose of responding to this RFP.

All information disclosed by FÒS FEMINISTA with regard to this Request for Proposal and during any subsequent negotiations shall be considered confidential information. Suppliers shall agree to hold such information in strictest confidence and will not use or disclose such information to any third party without prior consent from FÒS FEMINISTA.

Questions

For any questions on this RFP, do not hesitate to contact Viviane Gouredou, Lead, People & Inclusion at Vgouredou@fosfeminista.org

VERSION FRANCAISE

Appel à propositions- Société de gestion de voyages

Présentation générale

Objectif du projet

FÒS FEMINISTA lance le présent appel à propositions afin d’inviter des agences de services de voyage qualifiées, basées en Afrique, à soumettre une proposition. Au-delà des questions spécifiques énoncées ci-dessous, FÒS FEMINISTA recherche un partenaire qui :

  • Offre aux voyageurs un service client multilingue de grande qualité.
  • Fasse preuve d’une culture de service proactive et gère les dépenses de voyage de FÒS FEMINISTA avec le même niveau d’exigence que pour ses propres dépenses.
  • Dispose d’une expertise reconnue dans la réservation et l’organisation de voyages internationaux complexes.
  • Fournisse des rapports détaillés, remis dans les délais, afin de faciliter le suivi des dépenses et la conformité aux exigences d’audit.

Appel à propositions

FÒS FEMINISTA ne formule aucune déclaration, garantie ou engagement dans le cadre du présent appel à propositions. En outre, FÒS FEMINISTA ne s’engage pas à acquérir des produits ou services ni à entreprendre toute autre action, y compris, sans s’y limiter, à attribuer un contrat au fournisseur ayant soumis la proposition la moins coûteuse.

Les informations contenues dans le présent appel à propositions doivent être considérées comme confidentielles et exclusives, sous réserve des restrictions énoncées à la section Non-divulgation et confidentialité. FÒS FEMINISTA se réserve le droit de modifier ou d’annuler le présent appel à propositions à tout moment, pour quelque motif que ce soit ou sans motif particulier. Toute modification du présent appel à propositions devra être effectuée par écrit.

Calendrier de l’appel à propositions

  • Appel à propositions diffusé aux fournisseurs : 5 mars 2026
  • Date limite de réception des propositions : 30 avril 2026
  • Fin de l’évaluation initiale : 15 mai 2026
  • Entretiens avec les finalistes / Attribution du marché : 15 juin 2026
  • Mise en œuvre des services : dès que possible

Les dates ci-dessus sont susceptibles d’être modifiées, et les soumissionnaires en seront informés en conséquence.

À propos de FÒS FEMINISTA

FÒS FEMINISTA est une organisation féministe intersectionnelle engagée en faveur des droits et des besoins en matière de santé sexuelle et reproductive des femmes, des filles et des personnes de diverses identités de genre. Dirigée et gouvernée par des organisations du Sud global, elle agit comme une alliance d’organisations présentes dans 35 pays afin de faire progresser la santé, les droits et la justice en matière de santé et de droits sexuels et reproductifs.

FÒS FEMINISTA constitue un lien essentiel qui rassemble ces partenaires au sein d’une alliance et un acteur engagé dans l’écosystème plus large des organisations œuvrant en faveur de la santé, des droits et de la justice en matière de santé sexuelle et reproductive. Nous mettons en relation des partenaires au-delà des mouvements et des frontières, amplifions les solutions innovantes portées par nos partenaires et mobilisons la volonté politique ainsi que les ressources nécessaires au service d’un agenda féministe intersectionnel.

Aux côtés de nos partenaires, nous facilitons l’accès aux soins de santé et aux services essentiels. Pour plus d’informations sur FÒS FEMINISTA, veuillez consulter notre site internet : www.fosfeminista.org.

FÒS FEMINISTA compte actuellement 64 employées, dispose de bureaux à New York et à Mexico, et intervient dans les pays suivants :

Afrique : Côte d’Ivoire, Kenya, Nigeria, Sénégal Tanzanie

Amérique du Nord: Canada, États-Unis

Amérique latine et Caraïbes:

Argentine, Brésil, Colombie, Honduras, Mexique, Panama, Uruguay

Asie :

Inde, Philippines

Europe: Espagne, Royaume-Uni

Moyen-Orient:

Émirats arabes unis

Programme actuel de voyages

En 2025, les dépenses annuelles de voyage de FÒS FEMINISTA s’élevaient à environ 1 million de dollars américains. Plus de 90 % des déplacements étaient internationaux,

Politique et procédures actuelles en matière de voyages

Notre politique de voyages sera communiquée aux candidat·es retenu·es.

Processus et informations relatifs à l’appel à propositions

Soumission des propositions

Les propositions doivent traiter l’ensemble des points soulevés dans le présent appel à propositions et y apporter une réponse.

Les propositions devront rester valables et engageantes pendant une période de cent vingt (120) jours à compter de la date limite de soumission.

Questions et critères de l’appel à propositions

Exigences minimales (merci de répondre par oui ou non et d’apporter des précisions si nécessaires)

- Vous exercez votre activité depuis au moins cinq ans ?

- Vous disposez d’agents de voyage multilingues (Anglais, français au moins. La connaissance de l’espagnol est un plus) ?.

- Vous offrez un service disponible (24 h/24, 7 j/7) ?

- Vous offrez une gestion sécurisée des profils voyageurs ?

- Votre facturation inclue les codes budgétaires, les références et les autorisations requises ?

- Plus de 50 % de votre activité est liée aux voyages d’affaires internationaux ?

- Vous êtes éligibles pour servir une organisation financée par le gouvernement des États-Unis, les Nations Unies et l’Union européenne, et conforme aux réglementations applicables, y compris aux dispositions équivalentes à l’OFAC.

- Vous êtes membres en règle d’associations professionnelles du secteur du voyage ?

Même si le non-respect de certains des critères ci-dessus n’entraîne pas automatiquement la disqualification, ces éléments constituent des composantes essentielles de toute proposition et seront pris en compte lors de l’évaluation. Les prestataires satisfaisant aux critères éliminatoires ci-dessus sont invités à répondre aux questions suivantes :

Questions de l'Appel à propositions

Veuillez présenter vos réponses dans le strict ordre des questions ci-dessous et utiliser le plan des questions fourni.

Présentation générale

  1. Veuillez présenter votre équipe, vos services, ainsi que les raisons pour lesquelles vous souhaitez répondre à nos besoins en gestion de voyages. Merci également de fournir un bref aperçu des éléments qui, selon vous, font de votre entreprise le partenaire le mieux placé pour fournir des services de gestion de voyages à FÒS FEMINISTA.
  2. Veuillez décrire le calendrier de mise en œuvre et le processus en cas de sélection.

Expérience de l’agence

  1. Décrivez la composition de votre clientèle actuelle ainsi que votre expérience en matière de réservation de voyages dans le Sud global, en particulier en Afrique, pour les zones d’activité de FÒS FEMINISTA.

Approche technique des exigences de FÒS FEMINISTA

Gestion de compte

  1. Décrivez les principales responsabilités du gestionnaire de compte. Quelles sont ses compétences linguistiques ?
  2. FÒS FEMINISTA bénéficiera-t-elle d’une équipe dédiée et d’une personne de contact principale ? Les agents seront-ils en mesure d’apporter une assistance en matière de formation et de rapprochement des relevés de carte de crédit ?

Opérations

  1. Décrivez votre structure organisationnelle et vos modalités de reporting et de gouvernance.
  2. Décrivez vos opérations courantes, y compris, sans s’y limiter : l’emplacement du ou des centres d’appels, les heures d’ouverture, l’expérience moyenne des agents, le taux de rotation du personnel, l’automatisation et le contrôle qualité.
  3. Disposez-vous de capacités linguistiques, à l’écrit comme à l’oral ? Précisez notamment pour l’espagnol, le français et le portugais.
  4. Expliquez le processus standard de réservation des vols, les délais de réponse et le suivi des problèmes de service client. Disposez-vous de statistiques sur les délais de réponse ? Combien d’options présentez-vous ?
  5. Comment assurez-vous le contrôle qualité et l’absence d’erreurs dans les réservations ?
  6. Expliquez comment vous gérez les situations dans lesquelles un voyageur (ou un organisateur de voyages) a trouvé un tarif inférieur par une source alternative.
  7. Quelles procédures et quelles données utilisez-vous pour garantir la compétitivité de vos tarifs ? Disposez-vous d’un accès à des tarifs humanitaires si nécessaire ?
  8. Existe-t-il des transporteurs pour lesquels vous n’êtes pas en mesure de réserver des voyages, par exemple des compagnies aériennes qui ne distribuent pas leurs billets via les systèmes de distribution mondiaux (GDS) ?
  9. Il arrive que nous n’ayons pas besoin de réserver des vols et que nous ayons uniquement besoin d’une assistance pour la réservation d’hôtels. Êtes-vous en mesure de fournir ce service ?
  10. Proposez-vous un accès aux agents via des outils de messagerie tels que WhatsApp, Skype ou Microsoft Teams ?
  11. Décrivez votre service d’urgence en dehors des heures ouvrables, y compris, sans s’y limiter : l’emplacement du ou des centres d’appels, les horaires (24 h/24, 7 j/7), les coûts supplémentaires éventuels, l’entité qui exploite les centres d’appels, les normes de qualité appliquées, le nombre d’agents, l’accès aux informations et profils de paiement, les capacités linguistiques, etc.
  12. Veuillez fournir votre formulaire standard de profil voyageur. Disposez-vous d’un système automatisé de gestion des profils voyageurs ? Les voyageurs peuvent-ils accéder et le mettre à jour en ligne ? Où les profils sont-ils stockés ? Le système couvre-t-il les programmes de fidélité, les préférences de repas et de sièges ?
  13. Quels dispositifs de sécurité et de protection des données avez-vous mis en place pour garantir que les informations sensibles et confidentielles ne soient pas divulguées (par exemple : données de passeport des voyageurs, informations de carte de crédit, etc.) ?
  14. Vos agents maîtrisent-ils les exigences d’entrée sur le territoire et sont-ils en mesure d’identifier les obligations de visa en fonction des profils voyageurs ?
  15. Proposez-vous un flux de travail automatisé pour l’autorisation des voyages avant achat, incluant le suivi des codes comptables ?
  16. Fournissez-vous des notifications automatiques concernant les incidents liés aux voyages dans le monde (fermetures d’aéroports, grèves du personnel aérien, etc.) ?
  17. Fournissez-vous des alertes en temps réel, des services d’évacuation de sécurité et un soutien en situation de crise pour les situations émergentes dans les zones de destination des voyageurs ? Comment les voyageurs reçoivent-ils les alertes et les informations de voyage ?
  18. Comment les retards ou annulations en temps réel sont-ils communiqués aux voyageurs ? Existe-t-il une application mobile que les voyageurs peuvent télécharger ?

Financier - Tarification

  1. Veuillez fournir une tarification détaillée incluant tous frais supplémentaires ou annexes susceptibles d’être facturés. Merci d’expliquer en quoi le modèle tarifaire proposé est le mieux adapté à FÒS FEMINISTA.
  2. Veuillez préciser tout autre service ou produit entraînant des coûts supplémentaires.
  3. Seriez-vous en mesure de fournir un rapport mensuel de facturation dans un format spécifique, comprenant notamment : le nom du voyageur, la référence de réservation, les informations sur la compagnie aérienne ou l’hôtel, l’itinéraire, les heures de départ et d’arrivée, le coût total, les crédits ou remboursements, les frais internationaux, le taux de change et les frais d’annulation ?

Services complémentaires

  1. Veuillez décrire tout service ou avantage additionnel qui sera mis à la disposition de FÒS FEMINISTA et de ses voyageurs.
  2. Quels types de formation et d’outils d’orientation proposez-vous aux voyageurs, tant au début de la relation avec l’organisation qu’à l’arrivée de nouveaux voyageurs ?
  3. Proposez-vous des ressources pour accompagner ou gérer les démarches de visa ou de vaccination des membres du personnel de FÒS FEMINISTA en déplacement ?
  4. Disposez-vous de programmes liés à la durabilité environnementale ou à la compensation carbone pour les voyages ?
  5. Proposez-vous des programmes visant à sélectionner des modes de transport et des itinéraires à plus faible impact environnemental ?

Non-divulgation et confidentialité

Les termes du présent appel à propositions ainsi que l’ensemble des informations associées qui vous sont communiquées par nos soins sont confidentiels et protégés. Ces éléments ne peuvent être utilisés que dans le seul but de répondre au présent appel à propositions. Toutes les informations communiquées par FÒS FEMINISTA dans le cadre du présent appel à propositions, ainsi que lors de toute négociation ultérieure, sont considérées comme confidentielles. Les prestataires s’engagent à conserver ces informations strictement confidentielles et à ne pas les utiliser ni les divulguer à des tiers sans le consentement préalable de FÒS FEMINISTA.

Questions

Pour toute question relative au présent appel à propositions, veuillez contacter Viviane Gouredou, Responsable People & Inclusion, à l’adresse suivante : Vgourdou@fosfeminista.org.
